Class Sustenance

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.cards.Card
org.adsl.server.model.cards.events.Event
org.adsl.server.model.cards.events.Sustenance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Sustenance extends Event
Event card: each player must pay 1 food per character card they own, reduced by 3 food per Gatherer and by any DuringSustenance discount. For each character that cannot be fed the player loses lostPP PP instead.

    • activeEffect

      public void activeEffect(Set<Player> players, Trigger t)
      Resolves the Sustenance event for each player when t is Trigger.EVENT_EXECUTION. First activates any DuringSustenance building (via Event.activateBuildings(Player, Trigger)), then computes the food cost as the total number of character cards (all cards except buildings) minus a discount (3 food per Gatherer card plus BuildingBonus.getSustenanceDiscount()). The player pays as much of that cost as their food allows; for each unit of cost left unpaid, the player loses lostPP PP instead. The per-player BuildingBonus is reset at the end of processing.
      Specified by:
      activeEffect in class Card
      Parameters:
      players - the players affected by the event
      t - the trigger that fired; only Trigger.EVENT_EXECUTION is handled
